gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion

definitions.gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion
definitions.explanation: Refers to every instance or occurrence of something. Almost always appears in the pattern その都度 (on each occasion) or verb+都度 (each time something happens).

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{都度|つど}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Each time a problem arises, we deal with it on the spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な{都度|つど}、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}して→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please report to your supervisor whenever necessary.

examples.japanese: ⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{都度|つど}⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: There is a manual, but since the situation is different every time, we have no choice but to judge on each occasion.

notes:
{都度|つど} almost always appears in fixed patterns rather than being used independently.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{都度|つど} (on each occasion, every time)
- [verb]たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{都度|つど} (each time [verb] happens)
- ⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な{都度|つど} (whenever necessary)
- [noun]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{都度|つど} (on each occasion of)

The pattern ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{都度|つど} is by far the most common usage. It emphasizes responding to situations individually as they occur, rather than having a single fixed approach. Common in business and formal writing, but also used in everyday speech.
